plan.name: 12-Week Cycle-Aware Strength Program
plan.description: 12-week progressive strength program for a 28‑yr female recreational lifter. Phases and daily sessions adapt to menstrual cycle: cycle days 1–3 (flow) use low-intensity, low-impact, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping. GP cleared for exercise; program avoids high-intensity and heavy lifts on flow days. Start date: 2026-06-01. 3 training days/week strength with optional light aerobic/ mobility on other days.

goals.name: Increase overall strength
goals.description: Progressive overload across compound movements with cycle-aware intensity modulation

goals.name: Maintain training consistency throughout cycle
goals.description: Ensure training is feasible during flow days via lower-intensity sessions
